definitions.explanation: Jesus Christ, the central figure of Christianity. Also used in various compound terms relating to Christianity.

examples.japanese: キリスト{教|きょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じている→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧キリスト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生|たんじょう}→誕生：01460_tanjou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧だ。
examples.english: Christmas is a day to celebrate the birth of Christ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧キリスト{教徒|きょうと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧1⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the proportion of Christians in Japan is about 1 percent of the total population.

notes:
From Portuguese "Cristo" (Christ), introduced by Portuguese missionaries in the 16th century. One of the oldest loanwords in Japanese. Even though Japan has a small Christian population, キリスト appears frequently in daily life through terms like キリスト{教|きょう} (Christianity), which is taught in schools and appears in news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- キリスト{教|きょう}: Christianity
- キリスト{教徒|きょうと}: Christian (person)
- キリスト⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧: Christian church
- イエス・キリスト: Jesus Christ
- キリスト{教|きょう}⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧: Christian-affiliated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- イエス: Jesus — the personal name, sometimes used alone
- ⟦{救世主|きゅうせいしゅ}→救世主：27799_kyuuseishu⟧: savior, messiah — the meaning of "Christ" as a title

ETYMOLOGY:
Derived from Portuguese "Cristo," not directly from English. This is why the katakana spelling follows Portuguese pronunciation patterns rather than English ones.
